purpose: One bounded newly acquired historical evaluation of original versus half neutral bands; no trading
cross_scoring: All four trained models scored against BOTH original and half-band truth; zero band is raw-sign diagnostic only. Never compare accuracies on different labels as a model effect.
weighting: uniform across all mature outcomes including neutral
scaler: Unweighted train-only mean/std, refitted on each origin, same training rows across both bands
cutoffs: Strict future label endpoint before origin - 7 calibration days - 7 horizon bars; calibration endpoints strictly before origin - 7 horizon bars; calibration unused for tuning

bootstrap.family: half-logit/boost vs matched original-target model and random_uniform_3/majority_half/momentum_half, accuracy/macro-F1, 8 assets x 4 horizons = 512 comparisons

selection_policy: No threshold, hyperparameter, model, seed or stopping selection on October results; no promotion. All 80 fits and every registered comparison retained.
data_disclosure: October data unavailable locally before authorization; one 10-minute BTC endpoint probe inspected only status/count/time, no price/model analysis. Newly acquired historical data, not prospective; 13 days too short for final validation.

intake.crosscheck: Last 100 minutes of each symbol/batch via same-provider history-candles; not independent price validation
